overview:
Use case: style-transfer and precise-object-edit.
Edit target: Image 1, the existing axonometric cutaway rendering of option 5 of this apartment living room. Image 2 (a phone screenshot of a cozy living room) is ONLY the interior design and material style reference; ignore its screen frame, UI, fireplace, tall glass facade and ceiling beams. Image 3 is the existing floor plan, for room geometry and openings.
Request: Develop this SAME room and SAME option 5 layout into a much more cozy, warm, layered, plant-filled reading-and-cinema living room. Keep the elevated camera, landscape framing, cutaway roof, room proportions, foreground facade and door/window positions, rear interior doorway P7, left side passage and single arched niche, and existing medium-dark small-square parquet. No architectural changes.

Style from image 2: warm earthy natural palette, light oatmeal chunky woven linen/bouclé upholstery, substantial soft curved furniture, deep muted olive upholstery, warm brown walnut bookcases full of real books with a few ceramic vessels, aged terracotta planters, neutral nubby wool rug, pale warm limestone/travertine, cream throws and tactile cushions. Warm plaster walls with subtle mineral texture, EXCEPT the movie projection rectangle on the rear wall which must remain smooth matte pale neutral. All furniture should feel enveloping and lived-in rather than rigid or sparse.

Keep the main approximately260cm sofa in its original position parallel to the foreground facade, back toward windows and facing REAR wall. Replace its pink angular upholstery with a soft rounded oatmeal sofa of similar footprint, three generous seat cushions, supple arms, a thick cream throw. Replace the two spindly cane armchairs with TWO compact rounded olive-green upholstered lounge chairs, facing the sofa and slightly angled inward for conversation; move the right chair a little toward the center so it is clear of the new right bookcase. Preserve the left armchair's general place. Replace the small rectangular coffee table with a low rounded/oval pale travertine table, restrained size about90cm, keeping comfortable gaps between it and seating. Bigger tactile cream rug under entire seating group, with visible parquet border. A small wooden side table at the sofa's left end and one warm shaded table lamp, out of the passage.

ADD BOOKCASES: substantial floor-to-about220cm-high walnut bookcase on the RIGHT SIDE wall, roughly2m long and30cm deep, spanning its middle/rear section (floorplan y2.4 to4.5); this is the side wall perpendicular to the projection wall. Open upper shelves filled with books and some pottery, lower closed cabinets. Keep it away from the foreground small window/radiator. Do NOT put tall bookcases on the movie wall or across any doorway. In the EXISTING shallow arched niche on the LEFT wall, add two or three restrained wood shelves with books and small ceramics above the existing low storage; preserve the original arch, don't create a second niche.
ADD PLANTS: one large lush branching indoor plant in an aged terracotta pot near the front-left daylight zone, snug to the short solid wall before the lateral passage and clear of both the balcony door and passage; one medium leafy plant in terracotta near the inner front pier BETWEEN the large balcony door and small window, offset clear of the glass and radiator; two or three small plants/trailing greens on the right bookcase and left niche shelves. Natural irregular foliage, not identical artificial shrubs. Keep all major passages visibly clear, especially broad left lane and route behind sofa to balcony. No plant leaves encroaching on the movie image or in front of the radiator.
LIGHT: cozy late afternoon / early evening, warm amber shaded table lamps, subtle recessed shelf lighting in the walnut bookcase and arched niche, gentle daylight, shadows with depth. Cinematic coziness but bright enough to understand the whole room. Do not make a dark orange cave. Since ceiling is removed, do not show floating pendants, floating projectors or overhead equipment.
PROJECTION: keep the SAME rear-wall image area to the RIGHT of P7 and SAME low dark wood media console underneath. Project a faint peaceful landscape directly on smooth wall with NO television, black frame, hanging screen or fireplace. Keep the full image area clear; no pots, lights or plants in front of the projected rectangle.
Must keep: architecture, window count exactly2 on foreground facade (large sliding balcony door left; small window/radiator right), one rear interior doorway, one left lateral passage, one left arched niche, warm parquet, sofa orientation and cinema on REAR wall. No additional openings, no beams, fireplace, brick, slats behind projection, curtains over radiator, giant sectional or extra sofa. No people, labels, text, watermark. High quality photorealistic architectural visualization.
overview_correction: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this architectural cutaway with ONLY these two corrections, preserving the cozy style, furniture, camera, room geometry, all four existing openings, niche, parquet and projected image. (1) The terracotta pot and leafy plant that currently stand OUTSIDE the foreground wall, on the off-white exterior backdrop between the balcony door and small window, must instead stand INSIDE the room on the parquet, immediately behind that same solid pier between door and window. Remove every part of the outside plant and pot from the exterior backdrop. The inside pot may be mostly hidden by the cutaway foreground wall; its foliage should be visible rising INSIDE above the pier. Do not create an exterior terrace, no additional plant outside, and do not block the window/radiator or large balcony door. (2) The walnut bookcase on the RIGHT side wall should be about2m long, only in the middle/rear part of that wall. Shorten its foreground end so it begins around the level of the coffee table and finishes toward the rear corner, leaving the right wall beside the sofa and the radiator area completely clear. Keep it approximately30cm deep with books and warm shelf lighting, keep the wall flat where shelves were removed. Do not add another bookcase or move the sofa. Everything else identical. No text or labels.
interior:
Use case: photorealistic-natural / architectural interior visualization. Image1 is the revised cozy version of the user's actual room and is the main reference for palette, furniture and layout. Image2 is the user's cozy style inspiration only (ignore screen UI, fireplace, beams and different window architecture). Image3 is the authoritative original option5 floorplan for the room footprint and openings.
Create ONE photorealistic EYE-LEVEL interior view of this same revised living room, as if photographed from near the front-left corner looking diagonally toward the rear movie wall and right-hand bookcase. Camera approximately1.45m high, natural corrected wide-angle around24mm, no fisheye, spacious nearly-square room about5.64m wide by5.02m deep, ordinary plaster ceiling about2.85m high (illustrative).
Layout must match option5: big oatmeal rounded sofa260cm parallel to foreground facade, facing rear wall; viewer sees its back and left side at lower-right foreground, two compact olive lounge chairs at rear side of rug facing sofa angled inward; round pale travertine coffee table about90cm between chairs and sofa; dark walnut low media console against rear wall with a subtle scenic film projected directly above, rear interior white-trim P7 doorway to left of image area; LEFT wall has one rectangular lateral passage and ONE existing shallow arched niche further toward rear, niche has warm walnut shelves, books and ceramics. RIGHT wall is solid with a2m long,30cm deep, roughly2.2m high walnut bookcase only in its middle/rear section y2.4..4.5, not extending beside sofa or to facade; three compact bookcase bays full of books, some ceramics and trailing plants, lower cupboards. Keep doorways and movie rectangle unobstructed.
Style: faithfully reproduce image1's warm earthy cozy direction: textured cream sofa, muted olive chairs, soft plush large cream rug, linen throws, tactile cushions, warm walnut wood, real aged terracotta pots, rounded travertine table, books/pottery, wall sand subtle mineral finish EXCEPT smooth matte pale projection rectangle. Warm evening golden daylight from the existing windows BEHIND camera plus gentle2700K shaded table lamp at sofa left and subtle warm shelf/niche lights. Two small low-profile opal ceiling fixtures along LEFT half of room, no low pendants in movie axis. Cozy calm lived-in atmosphere, not a show home or orange dark cave. Ceiling must be plain white with existing simple white cornice, no beams.
Plants: lush plant on left foreground next to original front-left solid pier, second medium plant is INSIDE room behind the front solid pier between balcony door and small window (it may be out of view or partially occluded by sofa/camera); greenery on bookcase and niche. No plant outside the room; no pots blocking passages or radiator. The two facade windows are behind camera and need not be visible in this view.
Preserve existing small square wood parquet. No fireplace, TV, hanging projection screen, new window, third door, giant glass facade, artificial exposed timber beams, built-in platform, people, text or watermark. Keep scale realistic. Match this precise apartment, not the different architecture from style photo. Landscape composition.
